messages:
maria: heads-up — ran into friction with current /deploy workflow when we need to pin a model version and attach release notes. thinking a small CLI + bot fix.
kevin: tl;dr? :ear: 
maria: add new commands: `/deploy prepare <env> --notes-file=RELEASE.md --lock-version=sha` then `/deploy run <env> --canary X%` ; bot handles pinning and uploads notes.
sahil: love. can we auto-generate release note header from git metadata? e.g., `rnotes generate --from=HEAD~5 --to=HEAD` and produce yaml frontmatter
maria: example:

```yaml
version: 2026.03.20
changes:
  - id: 1234
    desc: fix kv-cache race
    owner: @sahil
migrations: []
```

kevin: also need `--preflight=smoke|full` so deploy-bot runs smoke tests before traffic shift
jen: we should standardize canary windows + automatic rollback thresholds (latency p95 + error rate)
sahil: propose defaults: p95_delta > 20% OR error_rate > 0.5% => rollback
ops-bot: note: adding preflight step will add ~30s to happy-path latency
rachel: what about templates for release notes? ops needs a single-line summary field for incident correlation
maria: new template idea: `templates/release/simple.md.tpl` with sections: TL;DR, Risk, Rollback Plan, DB Migrations
kevin: for rollback UX, add `deploy-bot rollback --fast-swap` to swap traffic to previous version instantly; require `--confirm` or 2fa for prod
maria: pushed a prototype CLI in git: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy-tools/pull/88 — feedback welcome :pray:
jen: can we make bot echo the generated release note to channel and pin it automatically
maria: yeah, `deploy-bot: pinned release notes for release/2026.03.20-rc3` (reaction :pushpin:)
kevin: small nit: `--lock-version` should write to a `pins/ENV.json` so dedicated and private deployments read same pin
sahil: tests: need unit for parsing rnotes and e2e for preflight gating
rachel: ok can someone draft a short RFC/Checklist? i'll take ownership of rollout thresholds
maria: assigning to @rachel for thresholds, @kevin for pin storage, @sahil for release note generator. i'll draft a short doc today
deploy-bot: preflight checks queued. run `deploy-bot status 1762001123` for updates
maria: thanks all — moving this to an agenda item for next release sync :rocket:
